thesis: The page is a workshop pegboard: every section hangs on painted tool outlines, and adding a job to the list lifts its tool off the wall into a running tray at the bottom of the screen.

signature.name: Pegboard Hang-Tag
signature.summary: A CSS primitive: 1px peg-hole grid background + tool-outline SVG with a hang-tag pill showing hours or price; lifts off the wall when added to the list.

motion.intro: Mosaic tiles drop onto pegs with 60ms stagger, settle with scale .98→1 micro-bounce, 900ms total, skippable.
stories: Hang-tags swing in (rotate -3deg→0 + opacity) as each service enters viewport.
Adding an item lifts its tool outline upward (translateY -12px) and fades into list tray.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms.
